name: C5 representative replay and controlled drift validation

representative_sample.source: held-out final-test lightpaths from the publisher test file
representative_sample.selection: 10 fixed evenly spaced observations from each of four ordered condition blocks for every final-test lightpath

controlled_drift_injection.name: CONTROLLED DRIFT INJECTION
controlled_drift_injection.description: Added a deterministic +2.0 dBm to optical power on a copy of every representative replay row; labels were unchanged.

conclusion: The representative held-out replay provides the lower-drift baseline; the controlled +2.0 dBm optical-power shift increases that feature's PSI from 2.724334 to 9.777087 and triggers the configured warning.
